description: This file is a JavaScript module that implements a lightweight API client for NetWeb Device Management. It provides functions for making HTTP GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests to a backend API, handling environment configuration, error parsing, and response processing.

methods.name: requireBaseUrl
methods.description: Ensures that the environment variable REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL is set; throws an error if not.

methods.name: parseError
methods.description: Parses error responses from the backend, attempting to extract meaningful messages from JSON or fallback to text.

methods.name: apiGet
methods.description: Fetches a resource from the API with optional query parameters.

methods.name: apiPost
methods.description: Sends a POST request with a JSON body to the API and returns the JSON response.

methods.name: apiPut
methods.description: Sends a PUT request with a JSON body to the API and returns the JSON response.

methods.name: apiDelete
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the API and returns true if successful.
